blocks.text: Isaiah 28 begins a commonly used reading division spanning chapters 28–35. This division can help readers navigate the book, but it is not proof that Isaiah consists of six separate authors or that its overall structure is undisputed.

The Great Isaiah Scroll preserves an almost complete text of Isaiah’s sixty-six chapters. It broadly agrees with the Masoretic tradition while also containing many spelling and substantive differences; other Qumran Isaiah manuscripts and interpretive writings likewise reflect active transmission and interpretation of the book.
